blocks.title: Half-life
blocks.text: Half-life (t₁/₂) woh waqt hai jis mein kisi reactant ki concentration gir kar apni original value (shuru wali qeemat) ki aadhi reh jati hai.
Half-life method se k nikalne ke liye yeh napa jata hai ke reactant ki concentration aadhi hone mein kitna waqt lagta hai.
Agar reaction first order ho to rate constant aur half-life ka relation (rishta) yeh hai:
Example (misal): hydrogen peroxide ke ek sample ki half-life 2 ghante hai aur yeh first order reaction se decompose hota (toot jata) hai. Is reaction ka rate constant k nikalein.

blocks.title: Sample Problem 7.2
blocks.problem: Cyclopropane ka propene mein badalna first order reaction hai aur is ki half-life 17.0 min hai. Is reaction ka rate constant nikalein.
steps: Step 1 Minutes ko seconds mein badlein: 17.0 × 60 = 1020 s
Step 2 Half-life ko formula mein rakhein: k = 0.693 / 1020 s

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne Sample Problem 7.2 ka jawab k = 6.79 × 10⁻⁴ dm³ mol⁻¹ s⁻¹ likha hai. Yeh second order ki unit hai. First order reaction ke rate constant ki unit s⁻¹ hoti hai (k = 0.693 / t₁/₂, yani 1/time), is liye sahi jawab 6.79 × 10⁻⁴ s⁻¹ hai.

blocks.alt: First order reaction ka curve: [A] vs time. Concentration c0 se girti hai; t-half par c0/2, 2 t-half par c0/4 aur 3 t-half par c0/8 hoti hai; dashed lines yeh values dikhati hain.
blocks.caption: First order reaction mein har half-life ke baad concentration aadhi (hamari apni drawing; kitab mein yeh figure nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: First order reaction mein half-life concentration par depend nahi karti: har t₁/₂ ke baad jo bacha hai us ka aadha reh jata hai. Teen half-lives ke baad sirf 1/8 bachta hai.

blocks.prompt: First order reaction ki half-life 15 minute hai aur reactant ki shuru ki concentration 0.100 mol dm⁻³ hai. Rate constant (k) nikalein.
blocks.explanation: k = 0.693 / (15 × 60 s) = 0.693 / 900 s = 7.7 × 10⁻⁴ s⁻¹. First order mein shuru ki concentration k par asar nahi karti, is liye 0.100 mol dm⁻³ hisaab mein nahi aata.

items: Half-life: reactant ke aadha hone ka time; first order mein k = 0.693 / t₁/₂ (time seconds mein).
H₂O₂: 2 h = 7200 s, k = 9.6 × 10⁻⁵ s⁻¹; cyclopropane: 17.0 min = 1020 s, k = 6.79 × 10⁻⁴ s⁻¹.
